title: Accounts
shortDescription: Manage all your bank accounts, wallets, and cash in one place
description: Track balances and transactions across multiple accounts. Add bank accounts, digital wallets, credit cards, and cash.
steps: Enter account name and initial balance
Choose account type (Bank, Wallet, Cash, etc.)
tips: You can archive accounts you no longer use
Set low balance alerts in settings
Link transactions to specific accounts

title: Categories
description: Create income and expense categories to track where your money goes. Customize with icons and colors. Install category packs from the Marketplace for ready-made sets.
tips: Use specific categories for better insights
Install category packs from Marketplace for curated sets (Vehicle, Wedding, Fitness, etc.)
Create subcategories under parent categories for detailed tracking
Archive unused categories

title: Tags
description: Tags let you group transactions across different categories. For example, tag expenses as 'Wedding', 'Vacation', or 'Side Hustle' regardless of their category. Filter transactions by tag and see tag-based spending analytics.
steps: When adding a transaction, scroll down to the Tags section
Tap existing tags to select them, or tap 'Add New Tag'
To filter by tag, tap the tag icon in the transaction list toolbar
View tag spending breakdown in Statistics → Spending by Tag
tips: Tags work across categories — tag a 'Wedding' expense in Food, Transport, or Shopping
SMS auto-import suggests tags automatically based on merchant names
Create tag-based budgets to limit spending on a specific tag
Use tags for temporary tracking (e.g., a trip or event) without creating new categories

title: Budgets
shortDescription: Set budgets by category, tag, or daily limit
description: Control spending by setting budget limits. Choose category-wise budgets for specific categories, tag-wise budgets for cross-category tracking, or daily budgets for overall spending control. Get alerts when you approach or exceed your budget.
steps: Choose budget type: Category-wise, Tag-wise, Daily, Festival, or Travel
For category-wise: select categories and allocate amounts
For tag-wise: select tags to track
tips: Use tag-wise budgets for events like weddings or vacations
Start with realistic budget amounts
Review and adjust budgets monthly
Recurring budgets auto-renew so you don't have to recreate them

title: Goals & Savings
shortDescription: Set financial goals and track your progress
description: Create savings goals for things you want to achieve — emergency fund, vacation, new phone, etc. Track your progress with visual indicators and get motivated to save.
steps: Enter goal name and target amount
tips: Break big goals into smaller milestones
Set realistic target dates
Review goals monthly and adjust if needed

title: Bills
description: Never miss a payment. Track rent, subscriptions, utilities, and other recurring bills with reminders.
tips: Mark bills as paid when completed
Get reminders 3 days before due date
Track overdue bills in red

title: Recurring Transactions
description: Set up recurring transactions for salary, rent, subscriptions. They'll be created automatically on schedule.
tips: Review recurring transactions monthly
Pause or delete when no longer needed
Edit amounts when they change

title: Trips & Split Expenses
shortDescription: Manage group trips and split expenses
description: Create trips, add participants, link transactions, and split expenses automatically. Perfect for group travel!
tips: Add participants before adding expenses
Active trips auto-link new transactions — just add normally
Choose equal, percentage, or custom split per expense
Export trip summary for sharing

title: Auto Import
description: Automatically detect and parse financial transactions from bank and wallet notification messages. Transfers between your accounts are detected automatically. Review and import with one tap.
steps: Review pending transactions in the Activity screen
Tap Approve to add as expense/income, or Transfer for account transfers
Tags are auto-suggested based on merchant names
tips: Review transactions before importing
Transfer detection links debit and credit SMS automatically
Auto-matching links to existing accounts by account number
Install bank-specific SMS parsers from Marketplace for better accuracy

title: Marketplace & Plugins
shortDescription: Extend the app with category packs, parsers, and more
description: The Marketplace lets you install category packs (Vehicle, Wedding, Fitness, etc.), bank SMS parsers, notification plugins, and export templates. Enable or disable plugins anytime.
steps: Go to Marketplace from the Utilities tab
Tap a plugin to see details
Toggle the switch to enable or disable
Category packs add new categories automatically when enabled
tips: Category packs are removed cleanly when disabled
Enable bank-specific SMS parsers for better auto-import accuracy
Some plugins are Pro-only — upgrade to unlock all
Configure plugin settings by tapping the gear icon

title: Backup & Restore
description: Export your data to JSON format for backup. Import previously exported data to restore transactions and settings.
tips: Backup regularly (weekly or monthly)
Store backups in cloud storage
Test restore on new device

title: Statistics & Reports
description: View detailed charts, graphs, and reports. Analyze spending by category, tag, and time period. Check your financial health score and spending personality.
steps: Choose time period (Today, Week, Month, Year, or Custom)
Check spending by category and by tag
Review 12-month trends and spending by day
tips: Review statistics weekly to catch overspending early
Tag spending breakdown helps track cross-category expenses
Financial Health score gives an overall picture of your finances
Pull down to refresh data on any screen

title: Security
description: Secure your app with PIN or biometric authentication. Keep your financial information private.
tips: Use biometric for quick access
Don't share your PIN
Change PIN periodically
